description: NADH shows two UV absorption bands: a strong nucleotide band at ~260 nm (ε ~14700) from the adenine ring, and a diagnostic reduced-nicotinamide band at ~340 nm (ε ~6220) arising from the dihydropyridine chromophore that is absent in oxidised NAD+ form.
transition: π→π* (dihydropyridine ring at 340 nm; adenine at 260 nm)
clinicalNote: The 340 nm band is the universal diagnostic wavelength for coupled enzyme assays (LDH, MDH, pyruvate kinase) and metabolic flux quantification in clinical biochemistry. NAD+ does NOT absorb at 340 nm.
